label: Iddo

A.name: Iddo
A.line: [grand] father of Zechariah the prophet (EZR 5:1, ZEC 1:1)
A.notes: listed among the priests of NEH 12:1-4, and was father of Zechariah (NEH 12:16)
family: father-of berechiah-6 (Berechiah, father of Zechariah the prophet (ZEC 1:1))
descendant-of aaron (Aaron, brother of Moses (EXO 4:14) and Levitical priest (EXO 28:1))

B.name: Iddo
B.line: Priestly family head returning with Zerubbabel, time of Nehemiah
family: ancestor-of zechariah-25 (Zechariah, head of the priestly house of Iddo in the days of Joiakim (N)

why: עִדֹּוא is one entry in a priestly list, fitting B’s description as a returning priestly family head. A’s notes also place him in this list, however, and verses 3–5 give no genealogy that distinguishes the two records, so B is only a tentative identification.
